subject: Marketplace SI bundle playbook and co-sell prerequisites
messages:
From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@acmesi.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: aws-partner-eng@amazon.com
Date: 2026-11-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Partner bundling: scope + next steps for marketplace listing

Hi Rishi / Laura,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Acme Systems Integration is evaluating a joint managed-service offering that bundles Redwood Hosted inference with our deployment and integration services. We want to surface this as: 

- an AWS Marketplace listing (Private Offers & AMI/SAAS bundle where applicable)
- a GCP Marketplace listing (consulting bundle)
- an initial pilot for a single enterprise customer (NDA in place)

Attached is a short scope doc that outlines the services we expect to package (attachment: acme-scope.pdf). High-level asks from our side: 

1) What are Redwood’s minimum co-sell requirements (e.g., co-marketing, pricing floors, lead registration)?
2) Any platform-level constraints for listing Redwood as a bundled SKU (metering, entitlements)?
3) Can Redwood commit to a co-sell contact at AWS during private offer setup?

We need a pragmatic playbook and an approximate timeline — our deal team is targeting a Private Offer by end of year. Can you propose a minimal set of artifacts we should prepare to get listing & co-sell approved quickly?

Thanks,
Jordan
Account Director, Acme Systems Integration
(jordan.price@acmesi.com)

--- attachment stub: acme-scope.pdf (1 page summary)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@acmesi.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-08T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Partner bundling: scope + next steps for marketplace listing

Jordan — thanks for the clear scope. This is exactly the sort of SI bundle we want to enable. Quick response with a pragmatic checklist and owners so we can move to an MOP: 

Core prerequisites (minimal viable bundle):
- Co-sell registration: SI must be registered with AWS Partner Network (APN)/GCP partner program. We’ll coordinate the Redwood partner contact with AWS.
- Listing type decision: SaaS subscription vs Private Offer. For Private Offers we’ll need pricing visibility and a Redwood PO owner.
- Security/compliance evidence: SOC2 summary + data handling note (we’ll provide).
- Technical package: deployment architecture diagram, entitlement model (how usage metering will be reported).
- Sales enablement assets: joint one-pager, pricing sheet, MOP (mutual action plan).

I attached our internal marketplace bundle checklist to speed things up. Please review and we can convert to an MOP doc with dates.

Action owners (initial):
- Acme: fill gaps in the attached checklist -> Jordan (due 2026-11-12)
- Redwood Sales: create HubSpot deal and assign DE -> Laura (will create today)
- Redwood Partnerships: intro to AWS co-sell contact -> Vivek (intro by 2026-11-09)
- Legal/Finance: prepare draft co-sell terms and PO workflow -> Laura (looping legal)

Attachment: redwood-marketplace-bundle-checklist.xlsx (internal workbook with checklist & minimum fields)

I’ll follow up with a short MOP template and proposed 3-week timeline.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Strategic Alliances, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

--- attachment stub: redwood-marketplace-bundle-checklist.xlsx

From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@acmesi.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-09T08:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Partner bundling: scope + next steps for marketplace listing

Thanks Rishi — that checklist is helpful. A couple of clarifying questions before we populate it: 

- Pricing floors: for Private Offers, does Redwood require a minimum list price or minimum commit to be eligible for co-sell? Our sales team prefers to keep margin room on services.
- Co-marketing: are there mandatory marketing activities (e.g., joint webinars, listings spend) for co-sell eligibility or is it optional?
- Doc/Signature: we normally get an MSA addendum signed before public listing; will Redwood accept a PO-level addendum (we can draft).

On the AWS side, I can also get an APN engagement email from aws-partner-eng@amazon.com if that helps for the co-sell introduction.

On timeline, the Acme-Cust pilot needs a private offer in place by 2026-12-15 to meet procurement windows. If we can lock the MOP by 2026-11-15 we should be able to get through procurement.

Jordan

On Mon, Nov 8, 2026 at 9:12 AM Jordan Price <jordan.price@acmesi.com> wrote:
> (attached acme-scope.pdf)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Jordan Price <jordan.price@acmesi.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, sales-ops@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-09T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Partner bundling: scope + next steps for marketplace listing

Jordan / Rishi — looping in Sales Ops and legal touchpoints to keep this moving. Quick checklist I will action: 

1) Create HubSpot deal and assign to AE -> DONE (HubSpot: https://hubspot.redwood/company/ACME-7842)
2) Draft co-sell addendum template (attachment: co-sell-terms-template.docx) -> legal review needed (target 2026-11-13)
3) Confirm AWS co-sell contact and intro: Vivek will handle
4) Confirm listing type (Private Offer vs SaaS) and required metadata for AWS/GCP -> Sales Ops to capture in workbook

Notes on pricing: we do not impose a hard minimum list price for Private Offers but prefer transparency on discounts to support co-sell claims. For co-marketing spend, it is typically negotiated; no mandatory spend for eligibility but joint marketing commitments improve placement.

Jordan — please confirm you can return the completed checklist by 2026-11-12 and whether Acme prefers a private offer for the pilot.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Partner bundling: scope + next steps for marketplace listing

Team — quick alignment and proposed timeline. Thanks Jordan for the fast turnaround on the scope. Summary and commitments: 

Summary
- Acme will target a Private Offer for the pilot customer (confirmed).
- Redwood will provide SOC2 summary, listing metadata template, and an intro to AWS co-sell contact.

Committed timeline (compact 5-step MOP):
- 2026-11-12: Acme returns completed checklist -> Jordan (owner)
- 2026-11-13: Redwood legal provides co-sell addendum draft -> Laura (owner)
- 2026-11-15: Partnership intro email to AWS & GCP co-sell reps -> Vivek (owner)
- 2026-11-20: Convert checklist into HubSpot quote + Private Offer draft -> Sales Ops
- 2026-12-08: Target internal approvals and DocuSign for pilot Private Offer

Owners / Slack tags
- Jordan (Acme): @Jordan.Price (Acme)
- Laura (Redwood): @laura_bennett (Sales Ops)
- Vivek (Redwood Partnerships): @vivek_kulkarni
- Rishi (Redwood): oversee and unblock

Notes: we recommend a canary listing approach — publish the Private Offer visibility to a limited account scope first, validate procurement flows, then broaden. This avoids catalog exposure while procurement closes.

I’ve uploaded the draft MOP to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood.com/marketplace/playbooks/si-bundle (mop-acme-redwood-v1.docx). Jordan, once you confirm the checklist date we’ll start the legal sprint.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Strategic Alliances | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
